question: What will be the closing value of the S&P 500 index (^GSPC on Yahoo Finance) on October 5, 2026?
resolution_criteria: Resolves to the daily close of ^GSPC on Yahoo Finance for 2026-10-05. If there is no close on that date (weekend or holiday), the last close before it is used.
research:
I couldn't reach Yahoo, FRED or CNBC pages directly, so the figures below come from search results quoting news reports. I left out anything dated after 2026-09-07.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question resolves on the Yahoo Finance ^GSPC daily close for 2026-10-05. That day is a Monday and a normal trading day, so the last-close-before rule shouldn't apply. I could not load the Yahoo history page (the proxy refused the connection).
- 2026-09-07: This is Labor Day, so US markets are closed. The latest close is the one from Friday, Sept 4.
- 2026-09-04: The S&P 500 closed at **7,718.60**, down 0.38%. The Dow closed at 53,414.25. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/03/stock-market-today-live-updates.html), [Investrade](https://investrade.com/market-review-september-04-2026/)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question. Resolution is about 20 trading days away, and the index sits in the middle of the 6,500 to 9,000 range.
- 2026-09-04: The index ended the week with a slim gain. It was about 1% below its mid-August record and up nearly 13% for 2026. [Khaleej Times/Reuters](https://www.khaleejtimes.com/business/wall-st-week-ahead-investors-to-pour-over-inflation-data-for-signals-on-rate-trajectory)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-04: August payrolls rose by 162,000 against a consensus of about 53,000, and earlier months were revised up by about 55,000. Yields and the dollar rose, and stocks fell as the odds of a Fed hike went up. [TheStreet](https://www.thestreet.com/stock-market-today/stock-market-today-dow-jones-sp-500-nasdaq-updates-sept-04-2026), [Yahoo/TheStreet](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/stock-market-today-sept-4-133716564.html), [Investrade](https://investrade.com/market-review-september-04-2026/)
- 2026-08-28: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh spoke at Jackson Hole. One secondary report says CME FedWatch then put the odds of a 25bp hike at the September meeting at 57%, up from 39.9% on Aug 21. The same report gives 12-month PCE inflation at 3.7% and Polymarket/Kalshi at about 48% for a hike. [KuCoin](https://www.kucoin.com/news/flash/cme-fedwatch-probability-of-fed-hiking-rates-in-september-rises-to-57)
- 2026-08-26: The index rose 0.30% to 7,677.24 ahead of Nvidia earnings, after dropping to about 7,641 on Aug 20. [Metatradingclub](https://www.metatradingclub.com/category/market-close/)
- 2026-08-13: Record close of **7,798.99**, up 0.65%, after soft PPI data. [Metrobank/Reuters](https://wealthinsights.metrobank.com.ph/news/us-stocks-sandp-500-notches-record-high-close-as-rate-hike-worries-ease), [Univest](https://univest.in/blogs/sp-500-today-record-high-7799-august-13-2026-rate-worries)
- 2026-08-26: The Motley Fool counted 27 record closes so far in 2026. [search summary](https://capis.com/?p=70408)

## 4. Base rates
- The level path runs from about 6,700 in mid-May [lbsim mirror](https://lbsim.ac.in/expert-time/SP-500-Could-Reach-8000-by-End-of-2026-Prediction-Markets-Suggest-3-410), to 7,736.52 on Aug 4, 7,798.99 on Aug 13, 7,641 on Aug 20, and 7,718.60 on Sept 4. The trend is strongly up since spring, and the index has moved sideways near its highs since early August.
- Typical variation, from my own calculation rather than a source: over about 20 trading days the S&P 500's standard deviation of returns is roughly 4 to 5%, or about ±300 to 380 points from 7,719. A 1-sigma band is roughly 7,350 to 8,080, and a 2-sigma band roughly 7,000 to 8,450. Fat tails matter if the Fed hikes.
- September is historically the weakest month for US stocks. [Khaleej Times/Reuters](https://www.khaleejtimes.com/business/wall-st-week-ahead-investors-to-pour-over-inflation-data-for-signals-on-rate-trajectory)
- I could not find the VIX level for Sept 4.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Kalshi or Polymarket market for the end of September or early October 2026.
- Undated: one source says the most likely Kalshi bracket for the year-end close is 7,600 to 7,799.99, at about 13%. [next.io](https://next.io/prediction-markets/trending/what-will-be-the-sp-close-price-end-of-2026/)
- 2026-05-13: Kalshi traders put the chance of the index crossing 8,000 before year-end above 50%. These copies sit on odd mirror domains, so treat them with caution. [lbsim mirror](https://lbsim.ac.in/expert-time/SP-500-Could-Reach-8000-by-End-of-2026-Prediction-Markets-Suggest-3-410)
- Late June 2026: JPMorgan raised its year-end target to 7,800. [Bloomberg Law](https://news.bloomberglaw.com/international-trade/jpmorgan-lifts-s-p-500-target-as-ai-rally-regains-momentum)
- In May, HSBC moved to 7,650 and Yardeni to 8,250. [Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/hsbc-yardeni-raise-sp-500-yearend-targets-on-earnings-strength-4675395)
- In March, Barclays moved to 7,650. [BNN Bloomberg](https://www.bnnbloomberg.ca/business/company-news/2026/03/24/barclays-raises-2026-year-end-sp-500-target-to-7650-despite-middle-east-inflation-risks/)
- Per one roundup, Citi, Oppenheimer and BCA are at 8,100 and BofA is at 7,100, the lowest. [ground.news](https://ground.news/article/jpmorgan-hikes-2026-s-and-p-500-target-but-sees-hurdles-ahead-for-stocks)
- I found no target revisions from the second half of 2026.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-09-11: August CPI. The Reuters poll expects +0.4% month over month for headline and +0.2% for core. [Khaleej Times/Reuters](https://www.khaleejtimes.com/business/wall-st-week-ahead-investors-to-pour-over-inflation-data-for-signals-on-rate-trajectory)
- 2026-09-15/16: FOMC meeting, with a possible 25bp hike from 3.50 to 3.75%. This is the main risk event. [KuCoin](https://www.kucoin.com/news/flash/cme-fedwatch-probability-of-fed-hiking-rates-in-september-rises-to-57)
- Mid-September: quarterly options expiration (triple witching, Sept 18) and the S&P rebalance. My assumption is that this falls on the usual third Friday.
- Late September: August PCE inflation data and the end-of-quarter rebalancing.
- 2026-10-02: The September jobs report is likely due this day (the usual first Friday). It is the last major data release before Oct 5.
- Possible risks: a government funding deadline on Sept 30 if one applies (not verified), and the start of Q3 earnings season, which mostly begins after Oct 5.
